title: Recover from missing assets and PDF failures
description: Report missing or corrupt assets and PDF-generation failures with affected resource/work identities, preserve authoring state, and prevent false successful artifacts or PrintPreparation records.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing, corrupt, undecodable, and incompatible assets identify stable asset and affected-work references
Renderer and download failures return structured stage-specific diagnostics
Any generation failure preserves projects, drafts, snapshots, assets, and prior valid preparations
No failed or partial generation creates a successful PrintPreparation, success announcement, or final downloadable artifact
Users can navigate to affected content and retry after correction with keyboard alone

steps.details: Resolve and validate every scene asset before rendering, returning affected record/asset identities and reason codes for missing or unusable resources.
Separate scene, render, finalize, download, and preparation-commit outcomes so success is recorded only after all required stages finish.
Show persistent diagnostics with links to affected content, safe retry, and focus/status behavior while preserving authoring state.
Test missing/corrupt assets and failures at render, finalize, download, and preparation commit boundaries for no false success.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use one small scene and bounded stage-failure fixtures.
A generated byte buffer alone is not a successful immutable preparation if required commit stages fail.
